name: interactive-xapi-designer
description: Design accessible SLS interactives and instrument them with meaningful xAPI learning analytics.

interface.shortDescription: Build SLS interactives with learning analytics.
interface.longDescription: Turns a learning goal into an accessible SLS interactive, then adds verified xAPI state and analytics that expose attempts, strategies, misconceptions, revisions, confidence, and progress for learner reflection and teacher insight.
defaultPrompt: Design an SLS interactive and add meaningful xAPI analytics.
Turn this lesson idea into an accessible virtual lab.
Instrument this interactive for learner reflection and teacher insight.
